name: Test 300 m (performance only)

terrain._todo: OQ-MAP-TERRAIN: every number here is a first guess to prove the height-field pipeline on the test map, not a design value. size_m is the ground's side (it replaces the top-level ground_size_m; generator.ground_size_m must match it). The flat centre keeps alesia's six spawns and the inner band level; the one hill sits more than 80 m out with a gentle side facing the centre (radius_m) and a steeper outer side (outer_radius_m). max_piece_slope_deg is the steepest ground a piece may stand on (step 4); max_piece_float_m is how far a piece's footprint corner may lie above or below the ground at its origin (step 4).

_note: TEST-ONLY performance map (M2P1A), not a design layout: a 300 m square filled with alesia's own cover, ring cover, decor and world kit types at alesia's density per area. The two piece files are generated by tools/gen_test_map.gd from the "generator" block below; do not hand-edit them, rerun the tool. Spawns are alesia's six spots, so a match on this map plays only its centre. Landmarks are alesia's, reused read-only for loot clusters and ground paint.

generator._note: Test-only numbers. Targets scale alesia's counts (75 cover, 48 ring, 20 decor, 21 structures on 160 m x 160 m = 25,600 m2) to 300 m x 300 m = 90,000 m2. Cover goes in the inner square |x|, |z| < split_m, ring cover in the frame outside it; split_m 115 gives both about the same density (264 / 230^2 and 169 / (296^2 - 230^2), the 296 being the ground less the edge margin). Structures and decor go anywhere. Gaps and clearances start from alesia_cover.json ring_rules. A target may miss by at most tolerance (fraction).
